title: Contact Modal
description: A lead-capture form in a Dialog, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Dialog, Button, Field and Alert primitives: a heading, a line of description and a Button that opens a Dialog holding name, work email, company and message fields; the form refuses an empty name or email, marks those fields invalid and focuses the first, and has its own loading, error and sent renders; responds to its container (@container) — the trigger stops filling its row at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the text sits beside the trigger at @lg, and the dialog sets name and email side by side and its buttons in a row once its own width allows.
